title: OpenComputer · Live response latency
description: Aggregate response latency across reporting machines. Customer, machine and trace identities are excluded.

options.content:
Live, aggregate Slack response timings across reporting machines. **First content** excludes the opening “Started” placeholder, but can include a thinking/progress update. It is not time to a finished answer. Refreshes every 30 seconds as telemetry arrives.

Charts use six-hour UTC buckets; p95 appears only with **20+ measurements**. The current bucket and current day are partial. Missing measurements are shown in coverage, not counted as zero latency. Traffic and model mix can change.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count(first_content_ms) > 0, quantile(0.5)(first_content_ms), NULL) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM turns WHERE $__timeFilter(sent_at) AND surface = 'slack' AND outcome = 'completed' AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY turn_id)

panels.title: First content · p95
panels.description: Selected time range; at least 20 measured turns.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count(first_content_ms) >= 20, quantile(0.95)(first_content_ms), NULL) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM turns WHERE $__timeFilter(sent_at) AND surface = 'slack' AND outcome = 'completed' AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY turn_id)
SELECT count(first_content_ms) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM turns WHERE $__timeFilter(sent_at) AND surface = 'slack' AND outcome = 'completed' AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY turn_id)

panels.title: Response timing coverage
panels.description: Completed Slack turns with a first-content timestamp / all completed Slack turns. Silent, failed and incomplete turns are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count() > 0, count(first_content_ms) / count(), NULL) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM turns WHERE $__timeFilter(sent_at) AND surface = 'slack' AND outcome = 'completed' AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY turn_id)

panels.title: First content · median and p95
panels.description: Completed Slack turns across reporting machines, in six-hour UTC buckets. Median needs one measurement; p95 needs at least 20. Gaps mean insufficient measurements. The latest bucket is partial.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(sent_at, INTERVAL 6 HOUR) AS time,
  if(count(first_content_ms) > 0, quantile(0.5)(first_content_ms), NULL) AS median,
  if(count(first_content_ms) >= 20, quantile(0.95)(first_content_ms), NULL) AS p95
FROM (SELECT * FROM turns WHERE $__timeFilter(sent_at) AND surface = 'slack' AND outcome = 'completed' AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY turn_id) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Recorded model first-token wait · median and p95
panels.description: Completed Slack turns across reporting machines, in six-hour UTC buckets. Median needs one measurement; p95 needs at least 20. Gaps mean insufficient measurements. The latest bucket is partial. This is the runner-recorded initial model wait; harness startup and model differences affect it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(sent_at, INTERVAL 6 HOUR) AS time,
  if(count(ttft_ms) > 0, quantile(0.5)(ttft_ms), NULL) AS median,
  if(count(ttft_ms) >= 20, quantile(0.95)(ttft_ms), NULL) AS p95
FROM (SELECT * FROM turns WHERE $__timeFilter(sent_at) AND surface = 'slack' AND outcome = 'completed' AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY turn_id) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Platform overhead · median and p95
panels.description: Completed Slack turns across reporting machines, in six-hour UTC buckets. Median needs one measurement; p95 needs at least 20. Gaps mean insufficient measurements. The latest bucket is partial. Derived startup and output-delivery overhead; not the entire response time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(sent_at, INTERVAL 6 HOUR) AS time,
  if(count(overhead_ms) > 0, quantile(0.5)(overhead_ms), NULL) AS median,
  if(count(overhead_ms) >= 20, quantile(0.95)(overhead_ms), NULL) AS p95
FROM (SELECT * FROM turns WHERE $__timeFilter(sent_at) AND surface = 'slack' AND outcome = 'completed' AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY turn_id) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: First content by startup path · median
panels.description: Six-hour buckets, split by startup path to help distinguish traffic-mix changes. Each point needs at least one measurement; small samples can vary widely.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(sent_at, INTERVAL 6 HOUR) AS time, path,
  quantile(0.5)(first_content_ms) AS median
FROM (SELECT * FROM turns WHERE $__timeFilter(sent_at) AND surface = 'slack' AND outcome = 'completed' AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY turn_id) WHERE first_content_ms IS NOT NULL AND path IN ('warm', 'new', 'prewarmed', 'resume')
GROUP BY time, path ORDER BY time, path

panels.title: Response timing coverage over time
panels.description: Coverage of first-content measurements among completed Slack turns. This does not measure coverage of the full machine inventory.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(sent_at, INTERVAL 6 HOUR) AS time,
  count(first_content_ms) / count() AS coverage
FROM (SELECT * FROM turns WHERE $__timeFilter(sent_at) AND surface = 'slack' AND outcome = 'completed' AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY turn_id) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Machines reporting health
panels.description: Distinct machines sending health samples in each five-minute bucket. This is a reporting count, not the number of machines expected to be online. The current bucket is partial.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(occurred_at, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time,
  uniqExact(host_id) AS machines
FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name = 'host.sample' AND host_id != ''
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Daily response summary · UTC
panels.description: Milliseconds. Partial days reflect only the selected range. p95 requires 20 measurements.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(sent_at) AS day,
  count() AS completed_turns, count(first_content_ms) AS measured_turns,
  if(count(first_content_ms) > 0, round(quantile(0.5)(first_content_ms)), NULL) AS median_ms,
  if(count(first_content_ms) >= 20, round(quantile(0.95)(first_content_ms)), NULL) AS p95_ms
FROM (SELECT * FROM turns WHERE $__timeFilter(sent_at) AND surface = 'slack' AND outcome = 'completed' AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY turn_id) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
